resources.string: Keeps Material You template themes in Gboard in sync with your wallpaper colors.

Gboard Material You is an Xposed module. It does nothing on its own: it runs inside Gboard once NPatch loads it.

Setup:
1. In the NPatch manager, patch your Morphe-built Gboard (local/manager mode) and install it with Shizuku.
2. In NPatch, enable Gboard Material You for Gboard.
3. Import and apply a Material You template theme (such as 3D_Template_MaterialYou.zip) with the Morphe theme importer.
4. Force stop Gboard, then open the keyboard.

The theme then follows your wallpaper colors and dark mode.

Logs: adb logcat -s GboardMaterialYou
